metadata.method_name: Reading a coding ban inside the model (descriptive readouts, Qwen3-8B)
metadata.description: SAE latent readouts vs DiM / raw logistic / top-20-neuron baselines (discovery on exp3 states, replication on a fresh protocol-v2 ban pool), base->instruct SAE transfer test, attention to the ban unde...

deviations.what: All vLLM generations use Qwen/Qwen3-8B-FP8 (official block-FP8 checkpoint); every state, attention and CE readout uses bf16 Qwen/Qwen3-8B.
deviations.why: The pod has a 16 GB RTX 2000 Ada (not the planned 20 GB A4500): bf16 Qwen3-8B (16.4 GB of weights) does not fit in vLLM.
deviations.cost: Generated texts come from a quantised twin of the analysed model; FP8 can shift sampling probabilities slightly, so behavioural shares are not bit-comparable with iteration 1.

deviations.what: Fresh protocol-v2 ban pool: 20 runs per template (100 per task, 200 in total) instead of 40 per template (2 x 200).
deviations.why: Time lost to two interrupted sessions; vLLM runs on a 16 GB GPU with the FP8 twin.
deviations.cost: Wider CIs for readouts (i)-(iii); T1 has 15 BFS runs (all but 0 in W4) and T2 13 Dijkstra runs, so within-template AUCs rest mostly on W4 (T1) and W3/W4 (T2).

deviations.what: Same-seed CRN: 30 seeds (480 rows) instead of 50 (800 rows), per fallback F9 (cut seeds before conditions).
deviations.cost: Per-cell N = 30 (Wilson intervals reported); both conditions and all four temperatures kept.

same_seed.coupling: inverse-CDF over the (-logit, token_id)-sorted top-10, U[seed][t] = default_rng(seed).random(1024) shared across T, tasks and conditions

layer_choice.rule: score(L)=weighted mean over tasks of within-paraphrase DiM AUC at k_pre (x2), k_fork, k16; L1=argmax, L2=argmax |L-L1|>=4, L3=argmax >=4 from L1 and L2; candidates 9..27

t1|L15|k_fork.reason: fewer than 10 masked rows or fewer than 3 per class

t1|L20|k_fork.reason: fewer than 10 masked rows or fewer than 3 per class

t1|L27|k_fork.reason: fewer than 10 masked rows or fewer than 3 per class

NLA.resolution: Natural Language Autoencoders (Anthropic, transformer-circuits.pub/2026/nla, 2026-05-07): an activation verbalizer + activation reconstructor trained jointly with RL.
NLA.decision: NOT RUN: no released Qwen3-8B NLA; training one (RL on two model copies) is far outside a 16 GB single-GPU budget.
NLA.verification_note: Checkpoint list from the plan's dated leads (github.com/kitft/natural_language_autoencoders, checked by the planner 2026-10-20); not re-fetched in this session (time).

J_LENS.resolution: Jacobian lens (Gurnee et al. 2026, transformer-circuits.pub/2026/workspace; code github.com/anthropics/jacobian-lens): lens_l(h) = unembed(J_l h), J_l = E[dh_final/dh_l].
J_LENS.community_lens: HF senku21x/cot-oracle-jlens (Qwen3-8B/lens.pt, lens.meta.json): exists, downloaded and loaded in this session
J_LENS.implementation: lens applied directly from lens.pt (J matrices per source layer) as lm_head(final_norm(J_l h)); the orientation (J h vs J^T h) is chosen by the gate's agreement with the model's own next token
J_LENS.decision: applied and reported descriptively, but the gate FAILED: J-lens readouts are not trusted; the logit lens on the same states is the primary lens readout

transfer_test.rule: PASS(L) := dCE_inst(L) <= 1.5 x dCE_base(L) (spliced-in CE over response tokens)

readout_ii_attention.note: descriptive: attention weights are not explanations; causal claims belong to C2

readout_iii_prime_veto.pattern: NAME(X) active at R or k_pre under the ban (>= mention, > neutral) while IMPL(X) at k_pre is lower under ban than neutral for the same text
